user_query: I need help figuring out how much gasoline I'll need for a long trip across California. I think I'll need about 166 liters. Could you also let me know how to stop the engine when I arrive?
potential_follow_ups: Prior to commencing the drive, kindly initiate the engine, ensuring all doors are securely closed and the parking brake is engaged. I am keen to avoid any mishaps on the highway due to an unfilled tank so round it to nearest hundredth and fill that in.
Could you provide me with the approximate distance between San Francisco and Rivermist? This information is crucial for my travel planning notes. Will I be able to get there?
user_intention: User wants to plan and prepare for a long-distance journey across California by using the VehicleControlAPI to: 1) Convert the estimated fuel requirement from liters to gallons for better understanding and planning, 2) Ensure the vehicle is ready for the trip by starting the engine, confirming all doors are closed, and the parking brake is engaged, and 3) Obtain the approximate distance between San Francisco and Rivermist to assess travel feasibility and incorporate it into their travel planning notes.
